findings.location: comment[cleavage agent details], 58 global rows (characteristics[enrichment process]=not applicable)
findings.message: Global runs were digested with trypsin after full chemical lysine acetylation (NAS-d3) and the authors searched them with Arg-C specificity; the SDRF carries only NT=Trypsin;AC=MS:1001251, so a pipeline driven by the SDRF would search with K/R specificity.
findings.evidence: Manuscript 2.3/2.6 and PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol: 'Arg-C as the cleavage enzyme' for global; Trypsin for phospho. Trypsin is spec-correct as the digestion enzyme, so not an error; consider documenting the effective Arg-C specificity (e.g. a CS= cleavage-site field or a comment column).

findings.message: Methods state 'acetylation [normal (d0) and heavy (d3)] at lysine residues, and at protein N-terminus'; SDRF has only d0 Acetyl at protein N-term. NAS-d3 labelling at protein level would also label free protein N-termini, so NT=Acetyl:2H(3);AC=UNIMOD:56;PP=Protein N-term;MT=Variable is plausibly missing.
findings.evidence: Manuscript section 2.6 wording is ambiguous; add if the reading 'd0 and d3 at K and protein N-term' is accepted.

findings.location: rows with data files 181207_OR996_2_phospho.raw (tech rep 1) and 20180824_OR996_1_phospho.raw (tech rep 2), source brain279_HC_phospho
